BOUNDARY: The proof contract's boundary checks are accurate. The zero case (f(0)=0 vs f(c_n)=1) correctly witnesses discontinuity. The n=1 case is valid with positive radius. Degenerate/endpoint cases correctly show that at shared endpoints (e.g., 1/(n+1)) all summands vanish, so the open cozero intervals remain pairwise disjoint and the sum is pointwise finite everywhere. The sum is well-defined and discontinuous only at 0.
